where: Phone queue: review, gate, and question rows
what: Requests are cut to fragments such as “Review ...”, “Approve adapt...”, and “Choose the rel...”.
why: I must open items individually to understand what needs me; I cannot scan the queue between meetings.

where: Laptop: gate briefing and discussion pane
what: The approval occupies a narrow sidebar while the comms conversation takes most of the window and is largely empty.
why: My current decision gets little reading space despite having a laptop-sized window.

where: Phone queue: Comms officer and Questions sections
what: Both the comms officer and Bridge FO ask me to choose the release window, under a count of six decisions.
why: I cannot tell whether these are separate decisions or two representations of the same request, or whether answering one clears both.

where: Phone gate: reply field, decision buttons, and send arrow
what: One text field serves both a direct message to the officer and a decision reason sent through the comms officer.
why: After typing, I must remember which control matches my intent; pressing the familiar send arrow can send my reason without making the decision.

what: The board identifies the failed check but offers no visible Retry control.
why: I know the list is incomplete, but cannot immediately ask it to check again before my next meeting.
